tagline: Fight giants outside. Destroy them within.
visual_concept: A monumental crowned stone Titan towers behind a tiny unarmed Keeper awakening the Aion Spark in a bright Greek-mythic sky world. The scale contrast, hand-cast light, warm gold, red mantle and turquoise scarf communicate mythic adventure and the game's outside-to-inside fantasy without depicting or claiming a gameplay screen.

app_icon_derivatives.submission_note: Dimension and byte-size checks pass, but this RGB/no-alpha file does not match the separately recorded Play 32-bit RGBA requirement; regenerate or confirm console acceptance before submission.

production_rules.app_icon: Use app_icon_source_v2.png as the current source of truth. Resize to the required opaque RGB dimensions without adding rounded corners; store platforms apply their own masks. Do not regenerate the current icon family from legacy app_icon.svg.
production_rules.adaptive_icon: Keep the time-sun seal and Aion spark in the central safe zone. Validate foreground against circle, squircle and rounded-square masks, plus Android themed monochrome mode.
production_rules.wordmark: Preserve the original proportions and clear space equal to at least one glyph-I width.
production_rules.launch_screen: Keep the composition static and centered with no gameplay UI, buttons, loading text, spinner, or progress treatment. Regenerate both wired PNGs from launch_screen.svg as exact-size opaque RGB derivatives whenever the source changes.
production_rules.store_graphics: Verify current platform dimensions and file-size requirements immediately before submission.
production_rules.screenshots: Never use the feature graphic or social card as a gameplay screenshot.
production_rules.edits: Preserve the sky, marble, bronze, aqua, coral, gold and deep-blue-outline roles; do not restore dark-biopunk, bone-monster or iris imagery.
